# bugs #4254: mcs51 --xstack: the zero test of a call's int result follows the restore of registers, which overwrites A and B

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/4254/
- Category: [Fixes](../../fix.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17228
- Recommended action: Apply the patch for #4253 and close.
- Patch: [bugs-4253.patch](../../patches/bugs-4253.patch), commit [`4c9b047ed`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/4c9b047edfdf3a026a7da04af30a2db0901614bc). Applies to r17228 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

With `--stack-auto --xstack`, the code for a call whose 16-bit result is tested for zero moves the
result to A and B for `orl a,b`, and then it restores the registers that were in use at the call
from the external stack. The inline restore reads each register through A. With
`--opt-code-size`, the restore loads A and B with a count and a register mask and calls
`sdcc_xpop_regs`. In both cases `orl a,b` tests other values than the result. The ticket's
`test(0x1234, 0x5678)` returns 1, and 0 is correct.

This was reproduced on r17193 in ucsim. The result is 1 with `--model-large --stack-auto --xstack`,
with `--opt-code-size` added to these options, and with `--model-small --stack-auto --xstack`. It
is 0 with `--model-large --stack-auto` and with `--model-large`. It is also 0 with
`--model-large --xstack`, where the code does not save a register around the call. The `--xstack`
programs were linked with the library of the model without `--xstack`, as in the ticket, and the
linker warns about conflicting options. On r17228, programs with `--xstack` link only with the
patch for local 0020, and the test under Verification shows the fault there.

## Cause

The cause is the one of #4253. `genCall` in `src/mcs51/gen.c` pushes A before `unsaveRegisters`
when `regs[A_IDX]` of the result is greater than 0, and the value is 0 when A has the low byte.
`genCall` does not push B. A change that pushes A alone leaves the `--opt-code-size` case of this
ticket wrong.

## Fix

The patch for #4253 fixes both cases, and this ticket does not need another change. `genCall`
pushes A before `unsaveRegisters` when the result has a byte in A. It pushes B too when the
result has a byte in B and `optimize.codeSize` is set. Only the restore with `sdcc_xpop_regs`
writes B, and `unsaveRegisters` emits that call only with `--opt-code-size`.

## Verification

`support/regression/tests/bug-4254.c` is part of the patch for #4253. It has the ticket's function
with a third parameter that selects the table element, before and after `#pragma opt_code_size`.
For each of the two functions it checks the return value and the arguments that `use` received,
for a result of 0, a result whose high byte is 0, and a result whose low byte is 0. Without the
patch, on r17228 with the earlier patches of this report, 6 of the 12 assertions fail for
`mcs51-xstack-auto`, which is the regression variant with `--stack-auto --xstack`. 4 of them are
on the first function and 2 on the second. The test passes without the patch for mcs51-small,
mcs51-large, and stm8. With the patches of this report on r17228, it passes for
`mcs51-xstack-auto`, host, stm8, ucz80, and six mcs51 variants: the four models, and
`--stack-auto` with the small and large models.

## Related

- #4253 reports the fault for a char result. Its entry has the history of the test in `genCall`
  and the results of the whole suite for `mcs51-xstack-auto`.
- The entry local 0020 has the patch that programs with `--xstack` need to link on r17228.
